name: doc-to-slides
description: Convert documents into slide decks — 100% offline desktop app

scripts.dev: npm run clean:electron && tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json && concurrently "vite" "wait-on http://localhost:5173 && electron . --dev"
scripts.build: npm run clean:electron && vite build && tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json && electron-builder --dir
scripts.build:installer: npm run clean:electron && vite build && tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json && electron-builder
scripts.test: tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json && node scripts/test-url-resolver.js && node scripts/test-deck-quality.js && node scripts/test-export.js
